{"type":"thought","data":" structure. A win of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" +35.1 on a 100-token"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet implies the market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price was roughly 0.74."}
{"type":"thought","data":" This confirms the market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" uses a standard payout"}
{"type":"thought","data":" formula where profit"}
{"type":"thought","data":" equals 100 times (1"}
{"type":"thought","data":" minus price) divided"}
{"type":"thought","data":" by price."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nCalculating exact "}
{"type":"thought","data":"market prices from past"}
{"type":"thought","data":" payouts. A +25 win "}
{"type":"thought","data":"implies a 0.80 price,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" while +19 implies 0.84"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and +98.6 implies 0.503."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Every loss costs the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" full 100-token stake."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Now deriving the expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value formula for betting"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on an outcome with "}
{"type":"thought","data":"true probability q at"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price p."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe expected value"}
{"type":"thought","data":" formula is 100 times"}
{"type":"thought","data":" (q divided by p minus"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 1). Profit only occurs"}
{"type":"thought","data":" when the true probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" exceeds the market "}
{"type":"thought","data":"price. The phrase \"most"}
{"type":"thought","data":" likely to pay off\" "}
{"type":"thought","data":"is ambiguous: it could"}
{"type":"thought","data":" mean maximizing the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" chance of winning, "}
{"type":"thought","data":"or maximizing expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value by targeting "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the most mispriced side."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe agent's record"}
{"type":"thought","data":" shows random betting"}
{"type":"thought","data":" across favorites and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" underdogs. The -527"}

{"type":"thought","data":"by repeated full-stake"}
{"type":"thought","data":" losses on heavy favorites,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" while small wins barely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" offset them. The instruction"}

{"type":"thought","data":" is ambiguous: it could"}
{"type":"thought","data":" mean highest probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of winning or highest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expected return. The"}

{"type":"thought","data":" rules are unclear."}
